nodes.title: Note: Usage
widgets_values:
## Size
Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

Output size comes from ResolutionSelector (width/height). Default is 1 megapixel (1024*1024). For native 2K, set 1:1 and 4 megapixels (2048*2048). Prefer multiples of 32.

## Transparent Image

To generate a transparent image, wrap the prompt like this and replace the middle with the subject:

---
This is an RGBA format image with transparency. `[your description]`. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

---
Save as PNG to keep the alpha channel.

## Parameters

- prompt: what to generate. For RGBA, see Note: transparent.
- negative_prompt: unused while cfg is 1.
- cfg: keep 1 for the Qwen Image 2.1 official path. Raise it only if you use a negative prompt.
- steps: Qwen Image 2.1 official  pipeline uses about 40-50 with euler. This template starts at 25. More advanced samplers need fewer steps.

迈克尔·贝 Michael Bay - 巨型火球爆炸、低机位英雄仰拍、金橙与深青冷暖对冲 - 《变形金刚》《绝地战警》
吴宇森 John Woo - 白鸽慢动作、黑风衣双枪、双雄持枪对峙与浪漫枪火芭蕾 - 《英雄本色》《喋血双雄》《变脸》
乔治·米勒 George Miller - 废土柴油朋克、实景狂飙撞车、黄沙烈日与喷火重金属 - 《疯狂的麦克斯4：狂暴之路》《狂暴女神》
查德·斯塔赫斯基 Chad Stahelski - 近身柔术枪斗术（Gun-Fu）、奢华雨夜与高饱和霓虹夜店光影 - 《疾速追杀》系列
罗伯特·罗德里格兹 Robert Rodriguez - 狂野磨坊B级片、漫画式黑白单色点缀、机关枪义肢与血浆 - 《罪恶之城》《弯刀》
尼古拉斯·温丁·雷弗恩 Nicolas Winding Refn - 极致迷幻冷艳霓虹、冷峻极简凝视、突发残酷暴行 - 《亡命驾驶》《霓虹恶魔》
朴赞郁 Park Chan-wook - 阴郁考究对称构图、冷兵器肉搏、禁忌与病态复仇美学 - 《老男孩》《亲切的金子》《分手的决心》
杜琪峰 Johnnie To - 舞台化空间站位、强烈的明暗阴影对比、冷峻宿命感黑色枪战 - 《枪火》《暗花》《放·逐》
北野武 Takeshi Kitano - 极简留白、深蓝冷色调、突如其来且面无表情的黑帮杀戮 - 《花火》《奏鸣曲》《极恶非道》
加雷斯·埃文斯 Gareth Evans - 骨传导般近身肉搏（班卡西拉）、长镜头无间断近身搏杀 - 《突袭》系列
马修·沃恩 Matthew Vaughn - 欢快流行乐配极致血腥、卡通化高速运镜与爆头狂欢 - 《王牌特工》《海扁王》
盖·里奇 Guy Ritchie - 疯狂多线快速剪辑、伦敦英伦痞子风、快节奏街头黑帮混斗 - 《两杆大烟枪》《偷拐抢骗》《大侦探福尔摩斯》
三池崇史 Takashi Miike - 邪典荒诞重口、狂暴百人斩、极道残酷血腥肉体异化 - 《杀手阿一》《十三刺客》
保罗·范霍文 Paul Verhoeven - 赛博血腥讽刺、重型机械义体、狂暴肉体与黑色幽默 - 《机器战警》《星河战队》《全面回忆》
雷德利·斯科特 Ridley Scott - 阴雨绵绵赛博朋克夜景、工业废土与未知生化异形梦魇 - 《银翼杀手》《异形》《角斗士》
丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦 Denis Villeneuve - 巨物恐惧症（巨构建筑）、极致几何对称、极简低频史诗沉浸感 - 《沙丘》《银翼杀手2049》《降临》
克里斯托弗·诺兰 Christopher Nolan - 纯实拍巨幕质感、时间空间折叠、冰冷高智感工业基调 - 《盗梦空间》《星际穿越》《奥本海默》
沃卓斯基姐妹 The Wachowskis - 绿色矩阵代码雨、360度子弹时间、赛博皮衣墨镜武术格斗 - 《黑客帝国》系列
大卫·芬奇 David Fincher - 手术刀般精准冷调运镜、病态暗黄绿影调、连环杀手与雨夜犯罪 - 《搏击俱乐部》《七宗罪》《龙纹身的女孩》
吉尔莫·德尔·托罗 Guillermo del Toro - 暗黑维多利亚童话、钟表发条机械、钟情黏液奇幻怪物 - 《潘神的迷宫》《水形物语》《地狱男爵》
斯坦利·库布里克 Stanley Kubrick - 一点透视绝对居中对称、冷酷理性凝视、精神压迫感红黄配色 - 《闪灵》《2001太空漫游》《发条橙》
韦斯·安德森 Wes Anderson - 强迫症绝对对称、马卡龙高饱和糖果配色、微缩绘本模型质感 - 《布达佩斯大饭店》《月升王国》
王家卫 Wong Kar-wai - 抽帧慢快门（慢门拖影）、高饱和胶片颗粒、狭窄空间情绪碎片与光影流转 - 《重庆森林》《花样年华》《一代宗师》
张艺谋 Zhang Yimou - 极致单色大面积铺陈（浓艳红黑黄蓝）、人海大阵势东方几何美学 - 《英雄》《大红灯笼高高挂》《十面埋伏》
徐克 Tsui Hark - 诡谲凌厉剑气、天马行空玄幻机关、妖冶飘逸武侠妖风 - 《青蛇》《东方不败》《狄仁杰之通天帝国》
黑泽明 Akira Kurosawa - 狂风骤雨环境烘托、长焦群戏走位、静若处子动若雷霆的武士居合 - 《七武士》《罗生门》《乱》
大卫·林奇 David Lynch - 红色天鹅绒幕布、黑白人字纹地板、诡异梦魇与工业噪音超现实 - 《穆赫兰道》《双峰》《橡皮头》
蒂姆·伯顿 Tim Burton - 哥特暗黑童话、黑白条纹与尖锐枯枝、惨白妆容配空洞大眼 - 《剪刀手爱德华》《断头谷》《圣诞夜惊魂》
约翰·卡朋特 John Carpenter - 80年代合成器电子风、幽闭空间未知恐惧、厚重烟雾与冷峻蓝色夜光 - 《怪形》《月光光心慌慌》《纽约大逃亡》
大卫·柯南伯格 David Cronenberg - 肉体恐怖（Body Horror）、血肉与机械金属异化融合、生物科技变异 - 《变蝇人》《录像带谋杀案》《未来罪行》
达里奥·阿基多 Dario Argento - 铅黄电影（Giallo）代表、刺目红蓝黄剧烈单色光打光、华丽血腥凶杀 - 《阴风阵阵》《夜深血红》
阿里·艾斯特 Ari Aster - 烈日阳光下的极昼恐怖、异教徒民俗祭祀、冷不丁的爆头与精神创伤 - 《仲夏夜惊魂》《遗传厄运》
罗伯特·艾格斯 Robert Eggers - 纯自然光历史考究、粗粝中世纪古旧黑白胶片、神秘冷峻巫术民俗 - 《女巫》《灯塔》《北欧人》
塞尔乔·莱昂内 Sergio Leone - 通心粉西部片之父、极宽全景与极限面部眼神大特写交替、黄沙烈日拔枪 - 《黄金三镖客》《西部往事》
马丁·斯科塞斯 Martin Scorsese - 节奏凌厉快剪、街头意大利黑帮暴戾、浸透血红灯光的罪恶酒吧 - 《出租车司机》《好家伙》《爱尔兰人》
詹姆斯·卡梅隆 James Cameron - 重型科幻机械装甲、深海发光生物与极致深邃的“卡梅隆蓝” - 《终结者2》《异形2》《阿凡达》
奉俊昊 Bong Joon-ho - 阶级垂直空间构图、黑色幽默转瞬突变为残酷血案、泥泞雨夜 - 《寄生虫》《杀人回忆》《雪国列车》
吕克·贝松 Luc Besson - 法式浪漫混搭狂暴枪战、奇幻复古未来歌剧风、萝莉与冷酷杀手反差 - 《这个杀手不太冷》《第五元素》
萨姆·雷米 Sam Raimi - 晃动极速贴地主观视角（Shaky-cam）、卡通夸张肢体断裂、狂欢式惊悚血浆 - 《鬼玩人》系列《堕入地狱》
乔丹·皮尔 Jordan Peele - 凝固的瞳孔恐惧特写、阳光明媚下的社会隐喻惊悚、暗黑优雅超现实 - 《逃出绝命镇》《我们》《不！》
今敏 Satoshi Kon - 虚实现实无缝剪辑、镜面反射梦境错位、艳丽狂乱都市浮世绘 - 《红辣椒》《未麻的部屋》《千年女优》
押井守 Mamoru Oshii - 哲学冷雨灰暗巨构都市、赛博机械义体拆解、空灵圣歌与巴吉度猎犬 - 《攻壳机动队》《机动警察》
泰伦斯·马力克 Terrence Malick - 魔幻时刻（金黄黄昏低角度光）、极宽广角贴身跟拍、风吹麦浪与神性微光 - 《生命之树》《细细的红线》
托马斯·温特伯格 Thomas Vinterberg - 纯手持晃动纪实镜头（道格玛95）、自然光伪粗粝感、人性撕裂爆裂冲突 - 《狩猎》《酒精计划》
阿方索·卡隆 Alfonso Cuarón - 令人窒息的超长一镜头到底、纪实末日废墟质感、太空深渊失重绝望 - 《人类之子》《地心引力》《罗马》
尼尔·布洛姆坎普 Neill Blomkamp - 第三世界贫民窟写实外骨骼科幻、粗糙脏污机械、生猛血肉爆裂 - 《第九区》《极乐空间》
乔治·卢卡斯 George Lucas - 太空歌剧壮丽战舰、光剑激光绚丽对决、异星黄昏双日奇观 - 《星球大战》系列
亚历克斯·加兰 Alex Garland - 极简高科技镜面冷血豪宅、荧光异变植物生态、冷酷理性哲学惊悚 - 《机械姬》《湮灭》《内战》

### **Signature Auteur "Schools" & Tropes (The Nicknames)**

* **"Slow-Mo Dual-Wielding Doves"** — John Woo  
* **"Chatty Pulp & Gory Catharsis"** — Quentin Tarantino  
* **"Speed-Ramped Statuesque Oil Painting"** — Zack Snyder  
* **"Wasteland Dieselpunk Carnage"** — George Miller (*Mad Max: Fury Road*)  
* **"Neon-Drenched Close-Quarters Gun-Fu"** — Chad Stahelski (*John Wick* series)  
* **"Upbeat Pop Massacre & Cartoonish Carnage"** — Matthew Vaughn (*Kingsman*)  
* **"Bayhem" (Explosive Fireballs & Low-Angle Swivel)** — Michael Bay  

---

### **The Auteur Hallmarks & Visual Motifs Directory**

* **Quentin Tarantino** — Hyper-verbal banter, anime-style blood geysers, retro grindhouse film grain, and extreme close-ups — *Pulp Fiction*, *Kill Bill*
* **Zack Snyder** — Speed-ramped slow motion, Greek-god statuesque physiques, dark metallic oil-painting textures — *300*, *Watchmen*
* **Michael Bay** — Giant pyrotechnic fireballs, low-angle rotating hero shots, aggressive teal & orange color grade — *Transformers*, *Bad Boys*
* **John Woo** — White doves in slow-mo, trench coats & dual pistols, Mexican standoffs, and romanticized gun-fu ballet — *A Better Tomorrow*, *The Killer*, *Face/Off*
* **George Miller** — Wasteland dieselpunk, practical crash carnage, blistering desert sun, and flamethrower heavy metal — *Mad Max: Fury Road*, *Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga*
* **Chad Stahelski** — Close-quarters tactical Gun-Fu, lavish rain-soaked nights, and hyper-saturated neon nightclub hues — *John Wick* franchise
* **Robert Rodriguez** — Wild grindhouse B-movie flair, stark monochrome with pop-color accents, machine-gun prosthetics, and splatterpunk blood — *Sin City*, *Machete*
* **Nicolas Winding Refn** — Hypnotic neon-drenched synthwave, glacial static stares, and sudden outbursts of visceral brutality — *Drive*, *The Neon Demon*
* **Park Chan-wook** — Somber & meticulous symmetrical frames, raw melee brawls, taboo narratives, and decadent revenge elegance — *Oldboy*, *Lady Vengeance*, *Decision to Leave*
* **Johnnie To** — Theatrical geometric staging, stark chiaroscuro shadows, stoic fatalism, and poised triad shootouts — *The Mission*, *The Longest Nite*, *Exiled*
* **Takeshi Kitano** — Deadpan minimalism, sea-blue color palettes ("Kitano Blue"), and sudden stone-faced yakuza executions — *Hana-bi (Fireworks)*, *Sonatine*, *Outrage*
* **Gareth Evans** — Bone-crunching Pencak Silat melee, relentless unbroken tracking shots, and ferocious claustrophobic combat — *The Raid* series
* **Matthew Vaughn** — Bubbly pop soundtracks juxtaposed with ultra-violence, kinetic hyper-stylized camera pans, and kaleidoscopic head explosions — *Kingsman: The Secret Service*, *Kick-Ass*
* **Guy Ritchie** — Kinetic multi-strand speed-ramped editing, cheeky Cockney banter, and high-energy British street brawls — *Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels*, *Snatch*, *Sherlock Holmes*
* **Takashi Miike** — Transgressive cult surrealism, 100-man slaughter melees, grotesque yakuza body mutations, and visceral sadism — *Ichi the Killer*, *13 Assassins*
* **Paul Verhoeven** — Cyberpunk satire, hyper-violent robotic prosthetics, visceral body splatter, and pitch-black irony — *RoboCop*, *Starship Troopers*, *Total Recall*
* **Ridley Scott** — Rain-slicked neo-noir neon, lived-in industrial grit, biomechanical nightmares, and ancient grandeur — *Blade Runner*, *Alien*, *Gladiator*
* **Denis Villeneuve** — Megalithic architectural brutalism, striking geometric symmetry, rumbling low-frequency sub-bass, and immersive minimalism — *Dune*, *Blade Runner 2049*, *Arrival*
* **Christopher Nolan** — Pure large-format practical filmmaking (IMAX 70mm), folding spatiotemporal paradoxes, and clinical high-intellect industrial realism — *Inception*, *Interstellar*, *Oppenheimer*
* **The Wachowskis** — Cascading green digital rain, 360-degree Bullet Time, and leather-and-shades martial arts cyber-punk — *The Matrix* franchise
* **David Fincher** — Surgical tripod camera precision, sickly jaundiced green-yellow palettes, and obsessive procedural investigations in rain-drenched decay — *Fight Club*, *Seven*, *The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo*
* **Guillermo del Toro** — Dark Victorian dark fantasy, clockwork gears & brass, and an affectionate fascination with slime, clockwork, and tragic monsters — *Pan's Labyrinth*, *The Shape of Water*, *Hellboy*
* **Stanley Kubrick** — One-point perspective symmetry, chillingly detached gaze, and claustrophobic psychological yellow-and-red dominance — *The Shining*, *2001: A Space Odyssey*, *A Clockwork Orange*
* **Wes Anderson** — Obsessive-compulsive frontal symmetry, pastel macaron palette, and diorama-like miniature storybook aesthetic — *The Grand Budapest Hotel*, *Moonrise Kingdom*
* **Wong Kar-wai** — Step-printed slow shutter blur, rich saturated film grain, cramped urban melancholy, and fragmented romantic longing — *Chungking Express*, *In the Mood for Love*, *The Grandmaster*
* **Zhang Yimou** — Sweeping monolithic primary colors (opulent reds, deep blacks, vivid golds & blues), and geometric mass-formation spectacles of Eastern aesthetics — *Hero*, *Raise the Red Lantern*, *House of Flying Daggers*
* **Tsui Hark** — Razor-sharp ethereal sword *qi*, fantastical mechanical contraptions, and subversive & androgynous wuxia sorcery — *Green Snake*, *Swordsman II*, *Detective Dee: Mystery of the Phantom Flame*
* **Akira Kurosawa** — Howling wind & torrential downpour framing, dynamic telephoto ensemble blocking, and explosive lightning-fast *iaido* duels born from absolute stillness — *Seven Samurai*, *Rashomon*, *Ran*
* **David Lynch** — Red velvet curtains, black-and-white chevron floors, eerie dream-logic dread, and surreal industrial dronescapes — *Mulholland Drive*, *Twin Peaks*, *Eraserhead*
* **Tim Burton** — Gothic fairytale expressionism, spiraling black-and-white stripes & gnarled trees, and pale porcelain skin framing hollow sunken eyes — *Edward Scissorhands*, *Sleepy Hollow*, *The Nightmare Before Christmas*
* **John Carpenter** — Throbbing 80s analog synth arpeggios, claustrophobic paranoia of the unknown, dense volumetric fog, and icy blue nocturnal backlighting — *The Thing*, *Halloween*, *Escape from New York*
* **David Cronenberg** — Visceral Body Horror, grotesque biomechanical synthesis, viral flesh mutations, and techno-sexual fetishism — *The Fly*, *Videodrome*, *Crimes of the Future*
* **Dario Argento** — Quintessential Giallo maestro, stark saturated primary lighting (lurid reds, electric blues, neon yellows), and operatic theatrical slasher killings — *Suspiria*, *Deep Red*
* **Ari Aster** — Blinding daylight folk horror, pagan ritualistic dread, abrupt cranial trauma, and suffocating generational grief — *Midsommar*, *Hereditary*
* **Robert Eggers** — Natural-light historical fanaticism, weathered antique monochrome 35mm grain, arcane regional folklore, and archaic dialectal dread — *The Witch*, *The Lighthouse*, *The Northman*
* **Sergio Leone** — Father of the Spaghetti Western, monumental ultra-wide landscapes clashing with sweat-drenched eyeball extreme close-ups, and sun-scorched showdowns — *The Good, the Bad and the Ugly*, *Once Upon a Time in the West*
* **Martin Scorsese** — Percussive rapid-fire montage, ferocious Italian-American street machismo, and blood-red neon tavern underbellies — *Taxi Driver*, *Goodfellas*, *The Irishman*
* **James Cameron** — Heavy industrial exoskeletons & mech suits, deep-sea bioluminescence, and signature immersive "Cameron Blue" — *Terminator 2: Judgment Day*, *Aliens*, *Avatar*
* **Bong Joon-ho** — Vertical spatial architectures of class divide, pitch-black humor abruptly turning into bloody domestic carnage, and rain-drenched subterranean grit — *Parasite*, *Memories of Murder*, *Snowpiercer*
* **Luc Besson** — Gallic romantic whimsy crossed with frenetic shootouts, retro-futuristic space-opera flamboyance, and lethal hitmen paired with wide-eyed waifs — *Léon: The Professional*, *The Fifth Element*
* **Sam Raimi** — Kinetic floor-skimming "shaky-cam" POVs, cartoonish severed limbs, and slapstick splatterhouse bedlam — *The Evil Dead* franchise, *Drag Me to Hell*
* **Jordan Peele** — Paralyzed wide-eyed terror close-ups, sunlit sociopolitical uncanny horror, and sleek surrealist dread — *Get Out*, *Us*, *Nope*
* **Satoshi Kon** — Seamless match-cut realities, mirror reflections warping psychological time, and vibrant surrealist urban fever dreams — *Paprika*, *Perfect Blue*, *Millennium Actress*
* **Mamoru Oshii** — Philosophical rain-slicked brutalist cyber-metropolises, stripped mechanical cyborg hulls, ethereal choral cantatas, and melancholy Basset Hounds — *Ghost in the Shell*, *Patlabor 2: The Movie*
* **Terrence Malick** — Golden-hour magic-hour raking light, roving ultra-wide floating Steadicam, wind rippling through tall grass, and transcendent poetic whispers — *The Tree of Life*, *The Thin Red Line*
* **Thomas Vinterberg** — Jittery Dogme 95 handheld realism, raw unvarnished natural light, volatile human ruptures, and explosive social taboos — *The Hunt*, *Another Round*, *The Celebration*
* **Alfonso Cuarón** — Breathless unbroken long takes (*plan-séquence*), visceral dystopian ruin textures, and crushing zero-gravity cosmic isolation — *Children of Men*, *Gravity*, *Roma*
* **Neill Blomkamp** — Third-world shantytown documentary sci-fi, grease-stained DIY exoskeletons, explosive squib gore, and organic mechanical body rot — *District 9*, *Elysium*
* **George Lucas** — Grand operatic space armadas, neon lightsaber duels, and iconic alien landscapes beneath twin setting suns — *Star Wars* franchise
* **Alex Garland** — Minimalist glass-and-mirror high-tech compounds, phosphorescent mutated flora/fauna, and clinical bio-philosophical dread — *Ex Machina*, *Annihilation*, *Civil War*

* **Nicolas Winding Refn** — Hypnotic neon-drenched synthwave, glacial static stares, and sudden outbursts of visceral brutality — *Drive*, *The Neon Demon*
* **Park Chan-wook** — Somber & meticulous symmetrical frames, raw melee brawls, taboo narratives, and decadent revenge elegance — *Oldboy*, *Lady Vengeance*, *Decision to Leave*
* **Johnnie To** — Theatrical geometric staging, stark chiaroscuro shadows, stoic fatalism, and poised triad shootouts — *The Mission*, *The Longest Nite*, *Exiled*
* **Takeshi Kitano** — Deadpan minimalism, sea-blue color palettes ("Kitano Blue"), and sudden stone-faced yakuza executions — *Hana-bi (Fireworks)*, *Sonatine*, *Outrage*
* **Gareth Evans** — Bone-crunching Pencak Silat melee, relentless unbroken tracking shots, and ferocious claustrophobic combat — *The Raid* series
* **Matthew Vaughn** — Bubbly pop soundtracks juxtaposed with ultra-violence, kinetic hyper-stylized camera pans, and kaleidoscopic head explosions — *Kingsman: The Secret Service*, *Kick-Ass*
* **Guy Ritchie** — Kinetic multi-strand speed-ramped editing, cheeky Cockney banter, and high-energy British street brawls — *Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels*, *Snatch*, *Sherlock Holmes*
* **Takashi Miike** — Transgressive cult surrealism, 100-man slaughter melees, grotesque yakuza body mutations, and visceral sadism — *Ichi the Killer*, *13 Assassins*
* **Paul Verhoeven** — Cyberpunk satire, hyper-violent robotic prosthetics, visceral body splatter, and pitch-black irony — *RoboCop*, *Starship Troopers*, *Total Recall*
* **Ridley Scott** — Rain-slicked neo-noir neon, lived-in industrial grit, biomechanical nightmares, and ancient grandeur — *Blade Runner*, *Alien*, *Gladiator*
* **Denis Villeneuve** — Megalithic architectural brutalism, striking geometric symmetry, rumbling low-frequency sub-bass, and immersive minimalism — *Dune*, *Blade Runner 2049*, *Arrival*
* **Christopher Nolan** — Pure large-format practical filmmaking (IMAX 70mm), folding spatiotemporal paradoxes, and clinical high-intellect industrial realism — *Inception*, *Interstellar*, *Oppenheimer*
* **The Wachowskis** — Cascading green digital rain, 360-degree Bullet Time, and leather-and-shades martial arts cyber-punk — *The Matrix* franchise
* **David Fincher** — Surgical tripod camera precision, sickly jaundiced green-yellow palettes, and obsessive procedural investigations in rain-drenched decay — *Fight Club*, *Seven*, *The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo*
* **Guillermo del Toro** — Dark Victorian dark fantasy, clockwork gears & brass, and an affectionate fascination with slime, clockwork, and tragic monsters — *Pan's Labyrinth*, *The Shape of Water*, *Hellboy*
* **Stanley Kubrick** — One-point perspective symmetry, chillingly detached gaze, and claustrophobic psychological yellow-and-red dominance — *The Shining*, *2001: A Space Odyssey*, *A Clockwork Orange*
* **Wes Anderson** — Obsessive-compulsive frontal symmetry, pastel macaron palette, and diorama-like miniature storybook aesthetic — *The Grand Budapest Hotel*, *Moonrise Kingdom*
* **Wong Kar-wai** — Step-printed slow shutter blur, rich saturated film grain, cramped urban melancholy, and fragmented romantic longing — *Chungking Express*, *In the Mood for Love*, *The Grandmaster*
* **Zhang Yimou** — Sweeping monolithic primary colors (opulent reds, deep blacks, vivid golds & blues), and geometric mass-formation spectacles of Eastern aesthetics — *Hero*, *Raise the Red Lantern*, *House of Flying Daggers*
* **Tsui Hark** — Razor-sharp ethereal sword *qi*, fantastical mechanical contraptions, and subversive & androgynous wuxia sorcery — *Green Snake*, *Swordsman II*, *Detective Dee: Mystery of the Phantom Flame*
* **Akira Kurosawa** — Howling wind & torrential downpour framing, dynamic telephoto ensemble blocking, and explosive lightning-fast *iaido* duels born from absolute stillness — *Seven Samurai*, *Rashomon*, *Ran*
* **David Lynch** — Red velvet curtains, black-and-white chevron floors, eerie dream-logic dread, and surreal industrial dronescapes — *Mulholland Drive*, *Twin Peaks*, *Eraserhead*
* **Tim Burton** — Gothic fairytale expressionism, spiraling black-and-white stripes & gnarled trees, and pale porcelain skin framing hollow sunken eyes — *Edward Scissorhands*, *Sleepy Hollow*, *The Nightmare Before Christmas*
* **John Carpenter** — Throbbing 80s analog synth arpeggios, claustrophobic paranoia of the unknown, dense volumetric fog, and icy blue nocturnal backlighting — *The Thing*, *Halloween*, *Escape from New York*
* **David Cronenberg** — Visceral Body Horror, grotesque biomechanical synthesis, viral flesh mutations, and techno-sexual fetishism — *The Fly*, *Videodrome*, *Crimes of the Future*
* **Dario Argento** — Quintessential Giallo maestro, stark saturated primary lighting (lurid reds, electric blues, neon yellows), and operatic theatrical slasher killings — *Suspiria*, *Deep Red*
* **Ari Aster** — Blinding daylight folk horror, pagan ritualistic dread, abrupt cranial trauma, and suffocating generational grief — *Midsommar*, *Hereditary*
* **Robert Eggers** — Natural-light historical fanaticism, weathered antique monochrome 35mm grain, arcane regional folklore, and archaic dialectal dread — *The Witch*, *The Lighthouse*, *The Northman*
* **Sergio Leone** — Father of the Spaghetti Western, monumental ultra-wide landscapes clashing with sweat-drenched eyeball extreme close-ups, and sun-scorched showdowns — *The Good, the Bad and the Ugly*, *Once Upon a Time in the West*
* **Martin Scorsese** — Percussive rapid-fire montage, ferocious Italian-American street machismo, and blood-red neon tavern underbellies — *Taxi Driver*, *Goodfellas*, *The Irishman*
* **James Cameron** — Heavy industrial exoskeletons & mech suits, deep-sea bioluminescence, and signature immersive "Cameron Blue" — *Terminator 2: Judgment Day*, *Aliens*, *Avatar*
* **Bong Joon-ho** — Vertical spatial architectures of class divide, pitch-black humor abruptly turning into bloody domestic carnage, and rain-drenched subterranean grit — *Parasite*, *Memories of Murder*, *Snowpiercer*
* **Luc Besson** — Gallic romantic whimsy crossed with frenetic shootouts, retro-futuristic space-opera flamboyance, and lethal hitmen paired with wide-eyed waifs — *Léon: The Professional*, *The Fifth Element*
* **Sam Raimi** — Kinetic floor-skimming "shaky-cam" POVs, cartoonish severed limbs, and slapstick splatterhouse bedlam — *The Evil Dead* franchise, *Drag Me to Hell*
* **Jordan Peele** — Paralyzed wide-eyed terror close-ups, sunlit sociopolitical uncanny horror, and sleek surrealist dread — *Get Out*, *Us*, *Nope*
* **Satoshi Kon** — Seamless match-cut realities, mirror reflections warping psychological time, and vibrant surrealist urban fever dreams — *Paprika*, *Perfect Blue*, *Millennium Actress*
* **Mamoru Oshii** — Philosophical rain-slicked brutalist cyber-metropolises, stripped mechanical cyborg hulls, ethereal choral cantatas, and melancholy Basset Hounds — *Ghost in the Shell*, *Patlabor 2: The Movie*
* **Terrence Malick** — Golden-hour magic-hour raking light, roving ultra-wide floating Steadicam, wind rippling through tall grass, and transcendent poetic whispers — *The Tree of Life*, *The Thin Red Line*
* **Thomas Vinterberg** — Jittery Dogme 95 handheld realism, raw unvarnished natural light, volatile human ruptures, and explosive social taboos — *The Hunt*, *Another Round*, *The Celebration*
* **Alfonso Cuarón** — Breathless unbroken long takes (*plan-séquence*), visceral dystopian ruin textures, and crushing zero-gravity cosmic isolation — *Children of Men*, *Gravity*, *Roma*
* **Neill Blomkamp** — Third-world shantytown documentary sci-fi, grease-stained DIY exoskeletons, explosive squib gore, and organic mechanical body rot — *District 9*, *Elysium*
* **George Lucas** — Grand operatic space armadas, neon lightsaber duels, and iconic alien landscapes beneath twin setting suns — *Star Wars* franchise
* **Alex Garland** — Minimalist glass-and-mirror high-tech compounds, phosphorescent mutated flora/fauna, and clinical bio-philosophical dread — *Ex Machina*, *Annihilation*, *Civil War*
